name: Lookout Cay True-True BBQ: Baked Mac & Cheese, Burgers & Rotisserie Chicken
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point · True-True BBQ, True-True Too & Serenity Bay BBQ
whyItWorks: At Disney's Eleuthera island destination, the Baked Macaroni & Cheese, plain cheeseburger/hamburger, and interior rotisserie chicken breast are the safest picks.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose a plain burger (white bun), Baked Macaroni & Cheese (with Lactaid), or interior white rotisserie chicken meat (peel off the lime/goat-pepper skin). Strictly skip corn on the cob, fried okra, and black bean salad.
watchOuts: Lime and Bahamian goat-pepper marinade on chicken skin (remove skin)
